gallery.sdist_example_scope: Explicit --skip-potential secondary packaging check; not real potential science acceptance

scientific_scope: Camera interpolation and keyframe state/display cuts; not molecular trajectory interpolation.
DX/MRC raw scalar values, explicit map geometry and rigid registered copies; no automatic sigma interpretation.
Computed potential is LPBE in kBT/e with explicit radii, preparation, temperature and display conversion; not affinity/free energy/nonlinear PB or validated ligand parameterization.
Whole-grid extrema are not surface extrema.
Native OpenGL no-ray/volume and Figure preserve PSE; GPU opacity/pixels may differ. Other ray paths retain CPU ray.
External tools are separately installed; PDB2PQR requires independent Python >=3.11.

observed_numerical_evidence.scope: Independent installed-wheel actual APBS tests; distance in angstrom, homogeneous potentials in kBT/e, Born energies in kJ/mol.
